name: hireflow
description: HireFlow - AI-Powered Recruitment Platform | 智能招聘 AI 辅助平台

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api -- --runInBand && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run db:setup && concurrently -n db,shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green,magenta "npm run db:serve -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev:wait -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run db:setup && concurrently -n db,api -c yellow,green "npm run db:serve -w apps/api" "npm run dev:wait -w apps/api"
scripts.dev:external-db: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
